e: From Swedish Fahlun + -ite, after a place in Sweden (nowadays written Falun).

q: He leaned against the fence, pulled a pear from his tunic and bit into it. His face puckered. "No good?" Alypius said. Augustine spat out the pieces. "Fah!" he said.
